answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The horizon graph is validated at intake and the echo frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and violet anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 14 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 819 takes that multiplied out, plus 264 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
